name: Aussie ISP
summary: Sydney budget dialup ISP (unlimited time/download $18.95/mo); dead c.2004 (D & M TECHNOLOGIES PTY LTD, ACN 095 128 966).

events.details: Last Wayback capture of own domain (c. 2004). Proposal's 2016-2017 window confirmed and sharpened to 'by Oct 2016' (site parked); the D&M ABN cancellation in Sep 2017 is the corporate full-stop. site retail — rebranded 'Aussielinx' — on 11 Aug 2015; 'Coming Soon' parked by 2 Oct 2016; original operator D&M Technologies deregistered 30 Sep 2017.
